Scholarship overview

The Schiavon scholarship supports journalism research at Melbourne. It is linked to research-degree admission and the award's subject requirements. Applicants should check the course admission dates and scholarship selection process, because a separate fixed closing date was not stated in the checked information.

Melbourne offers research degrees across its faculties and graduate schools. Named research scholarships can carry subject or background criteria in addition to the requirements for doctoral admission.
